notes: Version number and What's new in the app. A new version comes every 3 days (1.2, 1.3, ...) and opens by itself when you are online: no new APK to install
Esports Intel grade (A / B) on each Dota 2 match: roster, form, head-to-head, standings and sharp money, locked 1 minute before the start (lock icon), with won / lost once it is over
Each grade says whether it agrees with this model, and the A / B won-lost record is shown above the matches
Retune every 3 days: every 3 days the team K, player K, ridge strength and the per-map cap are re-checked against the newest results; settings change only when clearly better
Offline: the app opens the last version it saw, or the copy built into the APK
First version: model predictions, Polymarket prices, rosters and the scoreboard
